In Education & Research, cybersecurity & zero-trust covers architecture-level security programs: zero-trust network and workload design, identity modernization, threat intelligence and managed detection, cloud posture management, ai-specific security for models and agents, cyber resilience, and the compliance machinery (soc 2, iso 27001, pci dss, dora) that regulated industries must evidence. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: zero-trust architecture & implementation, threat intelligence & managed soc, identity & access modernization — delivered on Tele Medicine Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Research IP attracts nation-grade interest while campus culture resists control; ransomware closes institutions for weeks.
LMS, SIS, attendance and support-service data never meet; at-risk students surface at failure, not at drift.
Generative tools flood campuses with no policy infrastructure; detection arms races erode trust while legitimate assistive use goes ungoverned.

blocks.x: How we deliver it in this sector

The delivery pattern composes 7 services from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower — Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC, Identity & Access Modernization, Cloud Security & Posture Management as the usual core — sequenced through the Achala Method with sector controls: Export controls on research obligations shape the design from the first sprint.
Services we deploy in this sector

items: Never trust, always verify — zero-trust as an executable architecture, not a slide.
Detection that keeps pace — intelligence-driven SOC with the boring parts (tuning, coverage) done properly.
Identity as the perimeter — workforce, customer and machine identities on one governed plane.
Secure at the control plane — posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
classification-aware controls for sensitive research programs (export-control posture evidenced)
segmentation and recovery drills for academic continuity (restart time proven in exercises)

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: Export controls on research and Research ethics (IRB/ethics boards). human-subject and data governance for research.
